entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a complete piece of garbage and doesn't work.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that you're not satisfied with the device. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or is it more of a preference issue?
It's a fault! It's broken! The heart rate is all over the place. I don't have time to play games with it. I just want my money back.

I understand your frustration, and I want to help. For a reported defect, our standard process is to connect you with our technical support team. They can quickly troubleshoot the issue and confirm the fault before we proceed with a return.

Absolutely not. I am not spending another minute on this. I don't have time for your 'support' team to tell me to turn it off and on again. The product is garbage. I want a refund. Are you going to process it or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. Let me just place you on a very brief hold to review the full policy for your purchase. I'll be right back.
Thank you for your patience. I've just pulled up your order and our return guidelines. I see here that you received the item 30 days ago.
And? Don't tell me I'm out of luck. I will light up your company on every social media platform.
Not at all, sir. I've confirmed that you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return period. I can absolutely process that return for you right now. No need for tech support in this case.
Oh. Seriously? You can just do it?

Yes. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just pack the item in its original box, apply the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll be issued a full refund.
Okay. Well... good. That's what I wanted.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Will there be anything else today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
